items.title: The dimension formula for a dominant locally finite type morphism of integral algebraic spaces
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a dominant locally of finite type morphism of integral algebraic spaces over a locally Noetherian base, the dimension of the source is at most the dimension of the target plus the transcendence degree of the extension of residue fields at the generic points, with equality when the morphism is proper (statement lines 2810-2825). The proof (proof lines 2827-2887) derives the inequality from the pointwise dimension formula, and in the proper case reduces to a quasi-compact situation, produces finite surjective integral schemes over both spaces, and compares dimensions and transcendence degrees to invoke the case of schemes. H3: a reduction to the scheme case with a genuine comparison of dimensions and transcendence degrees, written out in full.
